sentences.text: Artpop -LRB- stylized as ARTPOP -RRB- is the third studio album by American singer Lady Gaga , released on November 6 , 2013 , by Streamline and Interscope Records .	Lady Gaga	Lady Gaga	Interscope	Interscope Records	studio album	studio album	Interscope Records	Interscope Records
Gaga began planning the project in 2011 , shortly after the launch of her second studio album , Born This Way .	studio album	studio album	Born This Way	Born This Way (album)

Work continued until 2013 while Gaga was traveling for her Born This Way Ball concert tour and recovering from surgery for an injury she had sustained while touring .	Born This Way	Born This Way (album)	Born This Way Ball	Born This Way Ball
Gaga described Artpop as `` a celebration and a poetic musical journey '' and an exploration of the `` reverse Warholian '' phenomenon in pop culture .
It displays an intentional `` lack of maturity and responsibility '' by comparison to the darker and anthemic nature of Born This Way .	Born This Way	Born This Way (album)
Gaga collaborated with longtime partners Paul `` DJ White Shadow '' Blair and RedOne and new partners Zedd and Madeon .	Zedd	Zedd (musician)	RedOne	RedOne	Madeon	Madeon

The lyrical themes revolve around her personal views of fame , love , sex , feminism , self-empowerment , overcoming addiction , and reactions to media scrutiny ; references include Greek and Roman mythology , and classic jazz and electronic musician Sun Ra .	Greek	Greek mythology	Roman mythology	Roman mythology	jazz	jazz	electronic	electronic music	Sun Ra	Sun Ra
Artpop also features guest vocals from T.I. , Too Short , Twista , and R. Kelly .	Too Short	Too Short	Twista	Twista	R. Kelly	R. Kelly
The release of Artpop was prefaced by a two-day album release party dubbed an `` ArtRave '' .	ArtRave	ArtRave

The album received generally mixed reviews from music critics , but was commercially successful , debuting at number one on the United States Billboard 200 with first-week sales of 258,000 copies , becoming Gaga 's second consecutive number-one record in the United States and selling 757,000 copies .	music critics	Music journalism
It also topped national record charts in five additional countries , and charted within the top ten in over twenty .
Artpop was the ninth best seller album of 2013 with 2.3 million copies worldwide .
It was included in several year-end lists by music critics and publications .	music critics	Music journalism

`` Applause '' was released as the lead single from Artpop on August 12 , 2013 , and was a critical and commercial success , charting within the top ten of more than twenty countries worldwide , peaking at number four on the US Billboard Hot 100 .	Applause	Applause (Lady Gaga song)	lead single	lead single
The second single `` Do What U Want '' was released on October 21 , and peaked at number 13 in the United States .	Do What U Want	Do What U Want
It was followed by promotional singles `` Venus '' and `` Dope '' shortly before the album 's release .	Venus	Venus (Lady Gaga song)	Dope	Dope (Lady Gaga song)
`` G.U.Y. '' was the third and last single released from the album .
Gaga promoted Artpop with several television appearances and performances , including her second Thanksgiving Day special .	Thanksgiving Day special	Lady Gaga and the Muppets' Holiday Spectacular
She also embarked on the ArtRave : The Artpop Ball tour in support of the album .	ArtRave	ArtRave
